description: This file handles session maintenance warnings, including building warning messages, determining delivery targets, and sending notifications via outbound payloads or system events.

methods.name: resetSessionMaintenanceWarningForTests
methods.description: Resets internal warning contexts and delivery runtime promise for testing purposes.

methods.name: loadDeliverRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the deliver runtime module.

methods.name: shouldSendWarning
methods.description: Determines if warnings should be sent based on environment variables.

methods.name: buildWarningContext
methods.description: Constructs a string key representing the current warning context for deduplication.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats milliseconds into a human-readable duration string.

methods.name: buildWarningText
methods.description: Generates the warning message text based on warning parameters.

methods.name: resolveWarningDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Determines the delivery target (channel, recipient, etc.) based on session entry context.
